name: Tsetse Fly
body:
GIANT TSETSE FLY
CR 1

Bristling with coarse hairs, this enormous fly’s legs twitch just before it launches into the air on buzzing wings. This giant brown fly has long legs, a bloated body, and a pronounced proboscis.

XP 400
N Medium vermin
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 13, flat-footed 10 (+3 Dex)
hp 15 (2d8+6)
Fort +6, Ref +3, Will –2
Immune disease, mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee bite +2 (1d6+1 plus disease)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 17, Con 16, Int —, Wis 7, Cha 2
Base Atk +1; CMB +2; CMD 15 (21 vs. trip)
Skills Climb +9, Fly +7, Perception +2; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Disease (Ex)

Sleeping Sickness: Bite—injury; save Fort DC 14; onset 1d2 days; frequency 1 day; effect 1d4 Wisdom damage and target is fatigued, cure 2 consecutive saves.

Taking a dose of arsenic grants a +4 alchemical bonus on the saving throw. Horses take a -4 penalty on their sav-ing throw against sleeping sickness but zebras are immune.

ECOLOGY

Environment any tropical
Organization solitary, pair, or swarm (3–12)
Treasure none
